# Odile Varga

Head of technical services for the network, based at the Main Street branch in Alder Falls. Odile owns bibliographic record quality, the local subject heading list, and the cataloging standards that all five branches follow.

During the [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]] she led the record cleanup, wrote the [[Bookwright export field map]], and ran the [[Duplicate records triage, 2026-03-24]]. She is the person to ask when a Fernbank record looks wrong or a local heading is missing.

Before joining the network in 2018 she cataloged music scores at a university library, and she still answers most questions about sheet music and recordings.
